data_infos.dataset_description: 教育部大專校院校務資訊公開的校級休學統計。本DAG以教育部統計處 student.csv 的學校代碼／名稱與縣市欄位建立校址縣市對照，只保留校址在新北市的學校；輸出休學總計、學生自請與學校勒令兩個小計及各原因。來源沒有學生年齡，18-35為unavailable。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch the specified UDB static CSVs with a browser User-Agent and percent-encoded URLs. The 114 directory currently contains academic years 111-113; the un_update file contains 105-110. Probe the other requested directories and include them if they become available, preferring the newest copy for duplicate academic years. Build a school-to-county crosswalk from the MOE student.csv files by school code first and school name second, normalising pre-reform county names and failing loudly if any UDB school remains unresolved. Filter by campus county New Taipei City. Parse counts with a standards-compliant CSV parser and never convert ... suppression markers to zero. For 111 onward, reconcile self-requested reasons to their subtotal, school-ordered reasons to their subtotal, and the two subtotals to the overall total. For legacy years, reconcile visible causes when their sum matches the legacy total; hidden cells or omitted historical causes are explicitly tracked as skipped checks, never filled with zero. Add a three-times annual scale guard and retain raw reason scope in breakdown.
